modules.scope: Minimal header-only compiler, invariant, version-value and cache-layout foundation.
modules.non_goals: Runtime version artifact, cache-topology discovery, native FFI and owning-module performance claims.
known_limitations: Compiler hints remain preconditioned and do not guarantee a cache hit or a chosen lowering.
Runtime topology and crash-reporting policy remain with their owning modules.
reopen_triggers: A real consumer exposes a correctness, security or missing-foundation defect.
A supported compiler or target invalidates the frozen code-generation contract.
A direct dependency changes Core semantics, or the public component/delivery boundary changes.
A strong peer proves a better complexity class or a reproducible material advantage for the same consumer contract.
modules.summary: P0 基础层已关闭；消费者性能声明由所属模块承担。

modules.scope: Current auto/safe member-hook intrusive-list capability, C++ API, implementation, direct consumer/dependency, delivery, documentation and P1 engineering evidence.
modules.non_goals: Full owning container, time/scheduler algorithms, reclamation or full intrusive policy matrix, C API/native FFI and Formal release certification.
known_limitations: The component is a 64-bit direct-member, stable-address primitive and fails closed for unsupported pointer-to-data-member representations.
It stores no owner, count, allocator, lock or reclamation metadata; callers own storage, synchronization and business-state mirrors.
Safe-link membership transfer, counted lists and the full Boost.Intrusive policy matrix remain outside the frozen consumer contract.
Engineering performance is qualified only for the frozen W1-WIN contract and retained live artifact bundle; Formal remains PENDING.
reopen_triggers: A named consumer exposes a correctness, security or missing-capability defect within this primitive's ownership boundary.
The algorithm, public API, layout, supported compiler ABI, dependency edge or delivery shape changes.
A mature same-contract peer proves a better complexity class or a reproducible material advantage on a normal consumer workload.
The engineering evidence bundle becomes unavailable, or the frozen contract, peer, machine or instrument identity changes and the claim must be renewed.
modules.summary: v3 已关闭：真实消费者形状、typed membership transfer、correctness/交付/文档和 Boost 同合同 5% P1 工程非劣门均已签署；Formal 独立待办。

modules.scope: Five header-only util_core primitives: random stream, intrusive strong ownership, lexical cleanup, compact spin locking and compiler-local type identity; including direct consumers, C++ API, delivery, documentation and tiered engineering performance.
modules.non_goals: util-runtime Registry/demangle, blocking or fiber synchronization, cryptographic randomness, weak/aliasing ownership, runtime-stable type IDs, downstream module closure, Native FFI/C API and Formal certification.
known_limitations: The P1 claim covers only the frozen W1-WIN Ref owning-handoff and short SpinLock consumer workloads; RNG remains correctness/diagnostic, the M1-MAC ultra-short diagnostic is order-confounded, and Formal remains PENDING.

Rng is non-cryptographic; Ref has one intrusive strong count without weak or aliasing ownership; SpinLock is unfair and only for very short low-contention regions; type identity is compiler-build-local.
The engineering bundle remains a live local artifact pending project-level retention and signing.
reopen_triggers: A real consumer exposes a correctness, security, ownership, API-usability or missing-capability defect within the util_core boundary.
Any of the five headers changes algorithm, layout, public API, direct dependency, supported compiler contract or delivery shape.
A mature same-contract peer proves a better complexity class or a reproducible material advantage beyond the frozen 5% margin on a normal consumer workload.
The engineering claim must be renewed after source, peer, contract, machine, instrument or evidence identity changes, or the retained bundle can no longer be replayed.
modules.summary: util-core-v1 CLOSED：五项 header-only primitive 的能力边界、异常/ownership、三平台 correctness/交付、C++ 易用性、依赖与 W1-WIN 同合同 5% P1 工程非劣门均已签署；后续 util runtime owning-demangle 重开不影响本组件，Formal 仍独立待办。

modules.scope: Clock, Unix timestamp, deadline/sleep and intrusive timer capabilities; C++ API, direct dependencies/consumers, delivery, documentation and P1 engineering evidence.
modules.non_goals: Calendar/time-zone/formatting, executor and periodic policy, cross-thread timer service, downstream closure, Native FFI/C API, stable C++ ABI and Formal certification.
known_limitations: Timer queues are caller-owned stable-node, single-owner primitives; callback execution, cross-thread routing and periodic policy remain with sched/io.
CommonTimeoutQueue has no current HYLE product consumer, so its complexity/correctness is closed but it carries no scheduler performance claim.
Coarse and profiling fast paths are capability-gated and platform-dependent; CPU accounting is limited to the current thread or process.
The P1 performance claim covers only the frozen W1-WIN scheduler lifecycle replay against the pinned Seastar peer; Formal and unmeasured clock/sleep families remain outside it.
Calendar/time-zone/text protocol support and Native FFI remain explicit negative space until a named consumer is admitted.

A clock algorithm, timer algorithm, public API/layout, direct dependency, supported platform primitive or source/static/shared delivery shape changes.
A mature same-contract peer proves a better complexity class or a reproducible material advantage on a normal time consumer workload.
The engineering evidence bundle becomes unavailable, or the frozen contract, peer, machine or instrument identity changes and the claim must be renewed.
A foreign-runtime, calendar/time-zone, virtual-clock, periodic or cross-thread timer consumer is admitted through a separately scoped capability decision.

modules.scope: Owning std::string runtime demangle and type_info convenience, single platform-demangler execution per public call, affected correctness/usability/docs and current source/static/shared delivery.
modules.non_goals: Registry product changes, dynamic module lifecycle or ModuleManager, async-signal-safe parsing, allocator-aware string types, util target split, dependency closure, Native FFI/C API, timing/SOTA claims and adjacent-module closure.
known_limitations: Demangling is a diagnostic cold path, is not async-signal-safe, may allocate internally on Itanium and serializes HYLE DbgHelp calls on Windows.
The owning convenience may throw standard string allocation or length exceptions; platform demangler failure returns the original symbol.
Registry views are owner-bounded borrows and Registry does not provide unregister, dynamic module unload or reader quiescence.
The P0 verdict signs complexity and cost structure, not timing SOTA, end-to-end inference performance or Formal certification.
reopen_triggers: A real consumer exposes a correctness, ownership, exception, usability or missing-capability defect within this boundary.
The demangle or Registry public contract, algorithm, layout, direct dependency, compiler/platform ABI or delivery shape changes.
A mature same-contract peer proves a better complexity class, or a profile proves demangle or named Registry lookup is a material hotspot.
A real demangle-only consumer proves the current util component closure is materially costly.
A named consumer requires async-signal-safe symbolization or dynamic module unload and quiescence.
